SRE Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 — Serving runtime errors in eu-west-1. Alert: high restart rate on inference pods, increased 5xx, autoscaler churn detected. Paging on-call: @Omar_Patel

Mia Chen: seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in inference-runtime logs across multiple nodes. Crashloops start after scale events.

Omar Patel: on it. I'm pulling kube events and autoscaler traces now. Do we have a recent autoscaler policy change?

Jess Rivera: we rolled in autoscale burst mode change at 12:15UTC (lower cooldown, higher target) for traffic spikes. Could be oscillation.

Omar Patel: yep grabbing events. `kubectl get events -n redwood-serving --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 50` shows repeated ScaleUp/ScaleDown within 30s windows. Node provisioning latencies ~60-90s, then pods start OOMing.

Mia Chen: logs snippet:
```
runtime: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 3.2GiB
container_restart_count=4 pod=serve-model-ww2-4
stack: /app/serve/infer loop
```

Don Park: customers reporting elevated error rates. Ops dashboard: 23% 5xx for embed endpoints, tail latency spikes. Which models are affected?

Jess Rivera: mostly large-decoder-variants (gpt-3.8-like quantized) used by dedicated customers and Hosted tier. Smaller variants OK.

Omar Patel: immediate mitigation plan suggestion: 1) Lock autoscaler to stable capacity (disable burst scaling), 2) Set nodegroup max surge to 0 (prevent rapid add/remove), 3) Temporarily pin traffic to smaller model variant for affected routes, 4) Cordone and drain noisy nodes for memory profiling.

Mia Chen: executing step 1 and 2 now. `infractl autoscaler update --cluster eu-west-1 --policy stable-cooldown=300 --burst=false` — applied. Confirmed: scale events reduced but incidents persist for pods already scheduled.

Omar Patel: pinning routes to smaller model for best-effort: `routerctl promote model:small/1 for route:embed-prod` — doing canary shift 10% -> 100% if stable.

SRE Bot: action log: autoscaler policy rollback applied by Mia Chen at 1745306921. Route pin request by Omar Patel at 1745306990.

Jess Rivera: customer impact quick calc: 8 hosted customers + 3 enterprise accounts affected, ~14% reduction in success rate for affected endpoints. We should notify CS.

Don Park: notifying CS and support with runbook summary. I also recommend collecting KV cache hit stats and model mem footprints for follow-up.

Omar Patel: draining a suspect node to repro: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-eu-west-7 && kubectl drain node/gpu-eu-west-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30` — observed immediate pod restarts on other nodes with OOMs. Suggest we reduce concurrent slot per GPU to 1 for large variants.

Mia Chen: temp config applied: per-gpu-concurrency=1 for affected model class. Monitoring for 5m.

SRE Bot: monitoring update at 1745307100: 5xx rate falling from 23% -> 9% over 3m, pod restart rate decreasing.

Jess Rivera: plan for next 24h: revert burst config entirely, add autoscaler stabilization window 5m, add mem-pressure alert thresholds, and schedule follow-up RCA with ML infra to assess quantization/alloc patterns.

Don Park: handing off to night on-call @Mia Chen at 1745307160. Mia, please escalate to oncall-manager if errors resurface after 2hr window. I've opened INC-4412 and notified CS. 

Mia Chen: ack. I'll keep the pinned routes and concurrency limits until post-mortem. Adding notes to the incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4412 :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. Next on-call: Mia Chen (shift start 1745307160).
